create_bedrock_knowledge_base: create a Bedrock Knowledge Base with auto-created S3 bucket, OpenSearch collection, IAM role, and data source
ingest_file_to_bedrock_kb: ingest a file into a Bedrock Knowledge Base by uploading to S3 and starting an ingestion job
auto_detect_bedrock_config: auto-detect data source ID and S3 bucket from an existing Bedrock Knowledge Base
create_opensearch_collection: create an OpenSearch Serverless collection with encryption, network, and data access policies
wait_for_ingestion_job: wait for a Bedrock ingestion job to complete or fail with configurable timeout
